newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare Health wins 6.1 pct rate hike.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare Health wins 6.1 pct rate hike.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc said Monday its Secure Horizons Medicare risk program had won an overall rate hike of about 6.1 percent for 1997.
The rise, awarded by the Health Care Financing Administration, compares to a 5.6 percent overall increase received for 1996.
PacifiCare's class A shares were up 1-7/8 to 79-5/8 and its class B shares were up 2-7/8 at 84-3/8 in early trading.
"Secure Horizons is the largest and, for four years, has been one of the fastest-growing Medicare risk programs in the country," PacifiCare said.

It said 1997 rate increases vary by state and other demographic factors. In California, the company will receive an increase of about 6.3 percent. The rise will be 6.2 percent in Oklahoma, 1.8 percent in Oregon, 7.5 percent in Texas and 4.4 percent in Washington.
